# Cast Echo — NEW RIC5-CE-01 through RIC5-CE-06

## Printed envelope and selected extension
Action;120feet for observing/binding the original;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP;the outer resolution is instantaneous. Keep the native promise to repeat a spell rather than Fate Echo's narrower nondamaging repertoire. This local procedure admits ordinary spell ranks0–9, damaging spells, creation spells and every native casting-time category subject to the exact category rules below. An actually acquired class card expressly tagged as a real spell is a spell mode, not excluded merely for being a class card; its independent acquisition/use/recharge predicates must actually be present on the new caster. A nonspell class technique, item activation, feat copy or Oracle Revelation is not turned into a spell by resemblance.

## Original record
Extend only Fate Echo's event-accounting predicates expressly here. The actual caster must personally perceive and identify the real original at its casting, with actual perception and line of effect within120feet. Store its immutable ordinary identity, exact authorized operative version/rank/school/mode, original caster, causal lineage and completed-casting timestamp. It must have completed a real resolution before the outer commitment. A miss, successful save, immunity or lawful zero-result resolution is still resolved; a countered/aborted spell, rumor, reconstructed past sight or still-held unreleased original is not. At outer commitment its age must be0..18 elapsed seconds inclusive. The original may be another caster's or the echoer's own. For an original Ready spell, freshness uses its paid preparation/casting timestamp, not the later release; it must nevertheless have resolved. Do not redate records, infer hidden grants from seeing an effect, or expose the private record to other actors.

## Exact eligibility and acknowledged narrowing of 'any'
The child needs a complete authorized operative source mode. Cast Echo temporarily waives ONLY that child's ordinary class-list, prepared/known repertoire and ordinary maximum-rank gate for this one use. This explicitly permits a rank8/9 ordinary child from a lower-rank Cast Echo provider when all other costs and independent credentials are genuinely satisfied. It does not grant a permanent entry, donor class, item, feat, ritual privilege, named quest credential, material, living/corpse substrate or charge. Missing implementation of an otherwise permitted child is an adapter prerequisite, not a new categorical ban. In particular, do not import Fate Echo's rank7 cap, nondamage restriction or its evaluator's two demonstrated modes.

NEW finite lineage exclusion: no child whose operative function is further spell replay/copy, storing/releasing another spell, granting another casting/repertoire permission or another temporal replay wrapper; no original descended from any such replay/copy. This excludes Cast Echo, Fate Echo, Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Arcane Echo's copied discharge, Delay/Quick Cast wrappers and comparable actual casting-access procedures by their operative function, not by loose flavor text. Actual concrete summon/body creation is not excluded merely because it is called a copy: a Simulacrum payload must obey this packet's separate donor-lineage and copy-function restrictions. A copied damaging summon remains a real paid creation, not a free copy of a donor's existing companion. Optional donor metamagic, matrix, class enhancements, previous target choices, rolls, damage roots and acquired credentials are never copied. The new caster may use independently lawful own modifiers only under their actual provider predicates and the child restrictions below.

## Two paid commitments and ownership
At outer declaration bind one original and forecast the full sequential outer/child transaction, including outer history/strain before the child's quote. Require sufficient real unreserved resources and credentials for both; reserve the child obligations exclusively without charging them early. Choose no substitute original later. Outer commitment pays17 plus actual outer modifications, spends its Action, updates its own class history and opens its ordinary counter window. A countered outer never commits the child; release only its unpaid reservation, not a paid refund.

On successful outer resolution revalidate/reprice the same child against actual intervening state. If blocked/unaffordable, spend no child costs, release its reservation and retain all outer expenditures. Otherwise perform a separate actual child commitment: pay its full actual rank/base/additional RP, material, HP, limited-use and other independent obligations once, update child history, and open the child's own Counterspell window. Use the exact observed source mode’s real price: an ordinary Counterspell child costs its ordinary5RP, not an unrelated same-name class card’s3RP. If the observed mode itself is the genuinely spell-tagged Wizard class Counterspell and the new caster owns its independent automatic card and available recharge, that actual mode’s3RP replacement price and recharge2 apply instead of additionally charging generic rank1 RP. A same name never substitutes a cheaper alternative mode or grants a missing class entitlement. Use the echoer's actual Cast Echo provider ability, PB and provider class level for explicit class-level scaling, with the child’s exact original rank/school/mode and independently applicable owned defenses. Explicit non-attack/non-save ability checks retain the source’s actual named ability/proficiency rule using the new actor’s real scores; they are not universally rewritten to the wrapper ability. The child is not a prepared Wizard matrix and gains no first-matrix exemption; temporary access is not an ordinary Shaman known-spell vent. No donor engine, cast-proc, refund, action or further-copy chain is inherited. Mandatory child bookkeeping, real source costs, intrinsic paid payload results and actual damage/healing/condition consequences remain. Outer normal hooks retain their own predicates. Do not suppress an intrinsic healing or resource effect solely because it is beneficial.

## Casting-time categories
Action or Bonus Action child: the outer's one composite Action supplies the child's casting time; no extra child Action/Bonus Action is charged or granted. This explicit acceleration does not waive any payment, component, target or counter requirement.

Longer child: the outer Action starts, but does not compress, the child's native uninterrupted work. Commit its costs/counter window at commencement, maintain a long-casting concentration burden, and spend each actual regular Action on that work while in initiative; outside initiative perform the full continuous real work. Actual unavailability, loss of required components, concentration loss, abandonment or a broken required work condition interrupts without refund. Perform completion-time target/substrate checks required by that exact source. Work cannot be banked through another spell, Ready, rest or suppression. A ten-minute Continual Flame child still requires600seconds after child commencement. No Ritual tag or Wizard book ritual waiver is inferred from a long casting time. An explicitly acquired ritual-mode credential remains separately required; the current ordinary tagged set has no admitted ritual conversion.

Reaction child: its actual native trigger and interruption checkpoint remain mandatory. A direct outer Action can supply a Reaction child only if a separately lawful Action opportunity genuinely occurs inside that same open native window; no such Action is manufactured. NEW practical Cast-Echo-only route: during ordinary paid Ready preparation designate the actual child-native Reaction checkpoint as the trigger. This particular held Cast Echo may release in that native interruption window before the parent outcome, using one real Reaction for the composite release/Reaction child, not two. It does not move the native checkpoint or admit an unrelated trigger. An ordinary Counterspell child still needs an actually perceived pending caster within60feet and obeys the existing one-attempt-per-pending-cast rule across ordinary/class Counterspell sources. A Shield child still needs its actual targeted-attack/Magic Missile checkpoint. Its paid child has its own counter window; it does not reopen a second outer window. This is NEW Cast Echo authorship, NOT an interpretation that ordinary Ready generally interrupts an attack midway.

## Ready and fresh result
For Action/Bonus Action children use the exact paid outer/reserved child sequence above. Fix original and its freshness at preparation; no freshness refresh or second outer casting occurs at release. Maintain real Ready concentration and its original next-own-regular-START deadline. After the normal perceived trigger completes, validate Reaction, held record and current actual child targets/geometry; an invalid uncommitted release may await a different actual matching trigger only while the same hold remains live. Child commitment occurs after a valid release and costs its own resources/history once. Longer children begin their full work after release, not before; the Ready burden is replaced by their long-cast burden. Reaction children use ONLY the explicit native-checkpoint exception just stated. A concentration child displaces incompatible concentration at its own commitment; ending the spent Ready burden is not an additional cast. A child counter does not restore old concentration.

Use fresh lawful targets/area/choices in the child's native range from the new caster, not an added120feet or donor origin. Roll fresh dice and apply current defenses. New spell/summon/body IDs retain creator, cost, ancestry and source-lifecycle records. Summon caps, corpse/gear ownership, resource limitations and removal are the exact child's, not this wrapper's shortcuts. Null is sampled at the child's actual source-defined damage-root creation; neither donor flags nor Spectral Army's later-discharge convention becomes universal. No additional per-round feat-copy allowance is introduced for Cast Echo. Full wrapper scheduling and arbitrary child adapters remain implementation work, not evidence supplied by these authored cases.

# Meta Surge — NEW RIC5-MS-01 through RIC5-MS-04

Action;one willing actual creature within120feet, including self;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP. On real resolution establish a nonconcentration benefit with an absolute deadline60seconds later. Actual consent, source/target paths and real class acquisition remain. A paid resisted/prevented effect grants no hidden diagnostic. This grants no metamagic mode, class card, feat, RP pool, sorcery pool or additional mode slot.

## Exhausted-provider admission and exact waived charges
At each personally modified spell's actual commitment while a live unsuppressed Meta Surge applies, choose exactly one genuinely acquired eligible metamagic mode and provider. NEW waiver includes both Mage Metaspell Access's1/long-rest use charge and the source-directed Metamagic Adept's1 sorcery-point charge. The numerical source balance MAY already be zero; for this one waived charge the usual availability-of-that-charge test is waived too. Acquisition, chosen mode, class/source eligibility, body/casting permission and compatibility remain mandatory. Preserve each actual ledger at its existing value: a0-use Mage remains0, a1-use Mage remains1;0..2 actual feat points remain0..2. There is no refill, new entitlement, negative debit, 'spend then refund', duplicated recovery event or unused-credit bank.

Mage Metaspell Access modifies a genuine Mage spell under its actual card, with the single mode permanently selected on acquisition. Metamagic Adept requires its actual personal-spellcasting/total-level4 acquisition and two selected modes; this spell does not approve the entire pending feat cohort. Its complete source-directed menu remains the comparison/qualified-operand contract, with actual campaign feat availability a separate prerequisite. Reach adds30feet only to a positive numeric casting range, not Self/Touch/unlimited or a separate effect radius. Widen adds5feet to one eligible circular/spherical radius or cone length. Sculpt chooses up to the actual provider's stated casting-modifier limit in the initial area, gives automatic initial save success and no damage where success normally halves damage; it neither erases later ticks nor overrides other non-damage successful-save consequences. One total metamagic mode per cast across the Mage card and feat remains; select the provider, do not combine a free class mode and free feat mode.

Only an expense explicitly owned by an actually authorized metamagic mode is waived. The concrete reviewed set here is the Mage use and the feat point; a future genuine metamagic provider must bring its complete contract, not merely a 'metamagic' tag. Parent spell RP, surcharges, components, consumed materials, normal-HP prices, paid Action/Reaction, Dissonance/Refrain, copy capture/allowances, concentration and recipient restrictions remain. Mage Resonance Surge is a separately paid2RP/short-rest enhancement, not automatically a waived metamagic charge. Wizard Matrix Mastery, Spell Tether, Overchannel, quick-cast spells and class/feat copies retain their actual separate costs and permissions. No RP/RC/HP conversion is introduced.

## Commitment, Ready, suppression and overlap
Determine the waiver when the modified spell actually commits; an intervening suppression before that commitment removes qualification, and ordinary resource availability then governs the attempt. An otherwise illegal declaration spends nothing. If a valid modified Ready spell commits under Surge at preparation, its modifier/payment is fixed: later expiry or suppression neither retrocharges a point/use nor removes the committed modifier. Release still needs the actual Reaction, legal trigger/targets, concentration and deadline; it has no second metamagic spend. Conversely a previously paid modifier is not refunded by a later Surge. A just-cast Meta Surge cannot waive its own precommit modification retroactively; another already-live application can qualify it normally if the actual mode applies.

Keep each application and original deadline. One effective waiver suffices; overlaps do not create multiple modes, pool capacity or charges. A successful recast by the same caster replaces that caster's previous Surge on the same recipient without refilling anything; sources on different recipients or from other casters retain their own clocks. A full/recipient-effective suppression removes the payment benefit for new commitments only, and resumption before expiry restores that benefit without replay. Actual dispel, source-specific removal or expiry ends only that application. Caster distance/death does not invent an ending for this nonconcentration spell. The current point/use accounting is a new local exception explicitly selected here; the original metamagic source text remains unmodified history.

# Erase from Reality — NEW RIC5-ER-01 through RIC5-ER-04

Action;one actual perceived creature within120feet;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP;nonconcentration. A currently willing recipient may accept without resistance. NEW an unwilling recipient makes one CHA save against the actual caster's spell DC; success negates both components, failure admits them subject to their actual separate defenses. There is no creature-type/CR gate by name, no damage and no universal 'mind-affecting' immunity. This does not take the recipient's Actions, so mere untargetability does not spend the whole-Action denial guard.

## Untargetable is not absent or invulnerable
While operative the body cannot be newly selected as an individual direct creature target of an attack, spell, feature or item use, whether harmful, beneficial, self-targeted or targeted by an ally. An unresolved direct effect that explicitly revalidates a creature target at resolution fails against it under that effect's actual paid-target lifecycle; no refund or replacement target is supplied. An already launched physical object/projectile governed by collision is not erased or deflected by this clause: its actual world/collision source must supply its later consequences. No generic projectile engine is claimed. Previously established attached conditions, damage-over-time, controls, restraints, concentration dependencies and effects which operate without selecting a new target continue under their own sources. Actual areas, environmental collisions, support, Falling and mundane custody still affect the real body. You may target a legal point/area without selecting this creature; that area's later snapshot includes the body when its own predicates qualify.

The recipient remains in its real place with real gear, visible/audible when ordinary senses permit, and can act/move/attack other legal targets using real budgets. It is not Invisible, Incapacitated, immaterial, removed from a plane or immune to damage. It cannot use a new self-buff requiring direct self selection during the protection; ordinary existing personal passive state is not a fresh targeting action. An established grapple retains its source and actual reach; Erase does not teleport either body or free the grapple. A deliberate new direct grapple attempt is blocked. Mechanical owner/source IDs remain valid private bookkeeping, not controller targeting permission.

## Temporary memory fading — bounded selected meaning
NEW at establishment snapshot other actual minds within120feet of the recipient with real line of effect and actual perception of that recipient at that moment. The recipient's own mind is excluded. Only these observers receive a source-owned reversible mask on their preexisting episodic/recognition links identifying that recipient: their remembered name, prior recognition and target-associated recollection cannot be used as presently recalled knowledge while the mask is operative. No observer is informed that a spell selected them or given hidden roster/identity metadata. It does not erase language, skills, general facts, loyalties or other people's memories globally; it does not authenticate a disguised recipient. Opaque barriers/out-of-range/unperceiving observers are not included and later entrants are not enrolled.

This is a mask, not deleted history. Diaries, ownership, friendship/faction records, consents, issued orders, cast receipts, hard-control history, resource debts and true world facts remain. A temporarily unavailable remembered justification does not undo an already-lawful transaction or refund it. New sensory observation and new learning remain possible: an observer can see an unfamiliar body now and remember that new event, but cannot recover masked old recognition through private engine entity IDs. Actual memory-interference immunity/prevention can defeat this component for that observer without granting direct targetability through the recipient's independent protection. This selected scope is an explicit completion of 'memory fades temporarily', not global amnesia or a sixth information presentation.

## One source lifetime and ending
NEW both components have the same source deadline: the caster's next future regular START, excluding a START already underway when applied; outside initiative use application+6seconds and preserve the registered clock through initiative changes. Extra turns add no endpoint. Successful same-caster recast on the same recipient replaces only that caster's old source; other sources remain independently keyed and identical protections do not add strength. Each observer retains the mask belonging to each live source; ending one cannot bypass another.

Actual suppression affects only the expressions in its true scope. Suppressing the recipient protection permits otherwise legal new direct targeting while suppressed; a remotely unsuppressed observer mask need not vanish merely because the body entered a local field. Suppressing an observer's mask makes its preexisting available memories usable there; no interval is replayed on resumption. Expiry, genuine full source removal or recipient's actual death removes this source's protection and masks permanently. Zero HP alone is not actual death. Ending a mask removes only its interference from whatever memories really remain: an independent Disrupt Memory deletion or other real edit made during the interval remains deleted/edited, while new memories stay new. Never restore an old serialized full-mind snapshot over later experience. Gear/collision, elapsed costs, completed damage and other applications are not rolled back. No cosmetics are declared cosmological reality erasure.

# Sequester — NEW RIC5-SE-01 through RIC5-SE-04

Action;one actual currently willing existing creature within120feet;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP. The creature must actually communicate informed current agreement to the chosen wake schedule and loss of agency; inability to express that consent is not manufactured from an old alliance or a corpse. No hostile/no-save prison or object/corpse preservation mode is added. Active Undead/Construct can qualify when their actual source provides agency and consent. Required range, perception and line of effect apply.

## Admission and useful suspension
NEW this replaces the historical Instantaneous placeholder with a continuing, nonconcentration magical application. The caster and recipient choose a finite future absolute wake deadline at commitment; no universal numerical maximum is added to a source that prints none, but a missing, infinite or unknowable deadline is invalid. Agreeing to a very long finite deadline grants no infinite resources, inaccessible setting knowledge or safe campaign skip. At resolution admit the actual loss-of-agency component through the same caster-target-encounter whole-Action-denial gate. Willingness alone does not bypass that gate or an actual Incapacitated/suspension immunity. If the suspension cannot genuinely establish, no separate free invisibility remainder establishes from that paid attempt; no guard is consumed without genuine admission.

On admission the same body becomes suspended: actual Incapacitated, Speed0, no voluntary speech, Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions or new orders. End its applicable existing concentration normally. Do not additionally assign Unconscious, automatic critical hits, Prone, death or Petrified merely by analogy. The body's existing posture, anatomy, HP, Wounds, gear, restraints, contact, collision and support remain real. Invisibility conceals its actual body and the real equipment worn/carried at admission while continuously in custody; dropped pieces become visible and later-picked-up cargo is not retroactively concealed. Ordinary sound/position knowledge does not become sight. True Seeing's accepted actual benefits see this Invisible body through darkness, not through real fog or walls. No unrestricted nondetection is granted.

## Exact clock matrix
Pause and store remaining time, without resetting, only intrinsic physical aging, breathing consumption, hunger/thirst/metabolic accumulation, and expressly biological disease/incubation progression. An explicit source imposing magical damage, saves, conditions or deadlines is NOT reclassified as biology by its name. No new poison/disease cure is created. Biological counters not represented in actual content remain explicit content operands rather than invented ages/rates.

The world clock, Sequester's wake deadline, every attached spell's duration, scheduled saves/damage/healing, explicit independent class/body lifetime, actual regular/virtual turn markers, recharge and rule-based beneficial-rest eligibility clocks CONTINUE. In particular poison/curse spell packets, Chill Touch's no-HP-gain deadline, existing Stable recovery deadline, real death-save opportunities and source-qualified passive regeneration remain governed by their own actual sources; this spell gives no blanket exemption or an invented pending-event bank. Sequestered time is not sleep, labor, study, a short rest or a beneficial long rest and earns no rest completion/RP recovery or skill progress. A rest interrupted by admission must satisfy its own restart rules later; do not count the same frozen interval as rest in another tracker. No off-screen free Actions or passive-resource duplicates arise. Explicit biological pause never doubles a source-owned spell deadline.

## Wake, rescue and component-specific suppression
A declared optional wake trigger is one bounded conjunction of at most three directly visible/audible conditions in the creature's actual local30-foot neighborhood, evaluated from that body's position with ordinary line of sight/hearing and physical occlusion. It does not use the suspended creature's voluntary senses or True Seeing; the magical trigger observes only ordinary local sensory input. No secret identity, alignment, thought, remote fact, true-password authentication or invisible entity lookup. Fix the predicates at casting; preserve the finite fallback deadline even with a trigger. Missed observations under actual suppression are not queued; a still-present state can be observed only while this application still exists.

The original caster can end this application with an actual Action while perceiving the same body within120feet and line of effect. Any actual helper can use one Action in real touching reach to wake this application, without needing the invisible body to be seen when its actual location/contact is established. Neither grants a remote free rescue or a new Action. The suspended recipient cannot independently act or dismiss while Incapacitated; the mandatory finite deadline and external rescues are explicit protections against an undefined permanent trap.

Positive post-defense/pre-temporary-HP damage wakes after the actual packet and immediate life/concentration consequences; absorbed temporary HP still counts, zero damage after defenses does not. No retroactive crit or damage modifier is created by waking. Actual death or a transition to zero HP from a separate nondamage cause ends the application; ordinary life rules then continue. An independently due Stable recovery or genuine passive HP gain is not a free Sequester heal and does not itself wake a still-live body unless a stated wake condition actually occurs. Moving/carrying/contact/Falling without damage does not automatically wake, and suspension supplies no Hover, support, damage immunity or transport permission.

Actual suppression of the SUSPENSION expression permanently ends this application and wakes it; it does not refreeze on leaving the field. Full source suppression likewise ends both expressions. A genuinely invisibility-only suppression leaves suspension operative and can allow invisibility to resume within the original deadline. These are NEW Sequester-only lifecycle choices, not general antimagic rules. When a real suppressor prevents admission itself, no dormant queued application is created. Dispel, deadline, successful rescue and other stated endings remove only this source's Incapacitated/Speed0/invisibility; independent conditions remain. Resume paused biological counters with their stored remainder at the real ending time, never a reset or catch-up. No new turn, Reaction refresh, duplicate due save or refunded hard-control history follows.

records.proposedProcedure:
# Simulacrum — NEW RIC5-SI-01 through RIC5-SI-06

Action;one actual perceived existing creature and a separately chosen legal arrival within120feet of caster;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP. Both native placements are one identity. Use the actual access school: Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard Illusion; Cleric/Mage Universal. There is no CR, size, living-only, class-level or creature-type ceiling added. A currently willing donor accepts; NEW an unwilling donor makes CHA against the actual caster's DC. Success prevents creation without refund or a profile/secret diagnostic. A hidden missing actual profile never becomes an invented bestiary. Self-copy is allowed. An actual copy-descended donor is ineligible, including this spell's prior duplicates, even when renamed, disguised, repaired or recast; mundane ancestry is not 'copy-descended'.

## Snapshot and creation
At actual resolution, after caster payment, interruptions and donor resistance, revalidate the same donor, its complete operative profile and the chosen whole-body arrival with perception, line of effect, support and no interior overlap. No substitute donor, remote unknown square or free push aside is allowed. The new body is independent physical presence, not a Mirror Image; private provenance records its original creator and donor identity without claiming a soul, afterlife or original civil/quest identity. For a self-copy the donor snapshot is AFTER this cast's RP/use/history/concentration consequences; it does not snapshot a prepayment version.

Copy actual size, anatomy, body mass, native movement, intrinsic ability scores, PB, legitimate proficiencies, senses, damage/condition defenses, innate/native/class actions, explicit attack/save DC operands, prepared/known/book-access content and currently accessible memories. Copy current normal HP and actual maximum, existing Wounds/Critical/injuries and physical losses, not an arbitrary half or automatic maximum. Derive AC from actual intrinsic body and functional replica equipment, excluding external temporary buffs. Do not copy another source's current temporary HP, concentration, live beneficial/harmful magical applications, bestowed permissions, owned summoned creatures, pending attacks/Ready holds, reserved transactions or active control over other bodies. Physical scars/injury persist even when a magical condition record does not. An actual active form's anatomy/profile may be copied, but its remaining source-granted maximum/end restrictions remain attached to this derivative; at that hard form endpoint the duplicate ends rather than obtaining an unprovided alternate body or fresh form use. This specific template choice is disclosed, not an unrestricted permanent-form exploit.

An independently acquired actual creator bonus to summoned-creature maximum HP applies only if its real source includes this creation; the duplicate starts no higher than its snapshotted current HP even when that bonus raises maximum. The worked Illusion/Universal creators have no acquired Conjuration creation bonus. Missing source formulas, statistics or required consumable credentials prevent that particular unsupported ability from being executed; do not pretend that a title or printed CR supplies them. A complete supported donor's ordinary attacks and spells remain real abilities, not harmless images.

## Bounded resources and copy functions
NEW create one persistent derivative resource account keyed by original creator plus actual original donor identity, not by ephemeral body ID. At first creation snapshot the donor's CURRENT unreserved RP/charges/ammunition/uses, Dissonance, last-spell/Refrain, positive recharge counters, prepared-family-used history and other finite expenditures after all preceding commitments. Bound assets, permits, unique quest/boss/artifact entitlements and another person's inventories do not clone. Explicit expiry/debt/one-time-use receipts retain their original ownership context and cannot be spent twice by being copied. Pools are independent from the original donor: spending the duplicate's ordinary RP does not drain the original, but a recast does not create a fresh derivative balance.

When the same creator later recreates the same donor, use the existing derivative account. Any current donor shortfall or new consumed/invalid entitlement can further reduce availability; recast never restores the derivative above its existing available amounts, clears its Dissonance/Refrain, resets a cooldown/use/history, or clones pending reservations. Keep the derivative account’s existing chronological last-spell/Refrain exactly; do not overwrite it with a new donor snapshot. Union actual spent one-use/prepared-family records, take the larger same-unit active Dissonance debt/positive cooldown, and clamp availability to the lower of the derivative balance and donor’s current unreserved amount. The new body’s real source maximum can change with an actually changed donor profile, but raising that maximum grants no current units; a lower maximum clamps availability. A changed profile cannot convert a pool into a different unit. The durable derivative actor-lineage ID owns its casting, hard-control, resource, recovery and source-END/Long-Rest histories; each recreated physical body has a separate body-instance ID. A new body ID never clears that actor-lineage history or provides a second source clock. This is operational identity, not a soul or original-donor identity claim. Real source-required time and costs, not new IDs, govern recovery. While an active body exists it can perform an actually legal source-qualified rest/recovery under real elapsed time, safety, food/water and limited-rest budgets; no foreign blanket 'cannot recover spell slots' rule is imported. An absent/ended derivative account performs no rest, work or recovery. Absolute deadlines continue. Re-creation snapshots current body HP/injury anew only after a genuinely new17RP cast, but never refills resource accounts for free.

Explicitly disable duplication, spell-replay/storage, further-casting-access grants and their copy descendants as executable functions on this derivative. It cannot cast Simulacrum/Cast Echo/Fate Echo or activate a copied spell-copy/casting-access engine to generate another generation or permission factory. This is a NEW restriction of full duplication; ordinary paid noncopy spells, native attacks, defensive/passive features and actual bounded intrinsic outcomes remain. A class feature requiring an original unique body/soul/quest/artifact credential is not replicated merely from its visible result. No XP or level/stat progression, independent feat selection, new permanent repertoire acquisition or native source rewrite occurs; it can form new ordinary episodic memories and perform source-qualified mundane tasks with actual tools, knowledge, work and supplies. Its stored accessible belief is private to that creature; copying it does not give the creator a secret-data dump, true answers or access to sealed memories. A lawful order/question may obtain an answer the duplicate genuinely knows and can communicate, not a global truth oracle.

## Gear and economic identity
Create functional nontransferable replica props for ordinary nonunique mundane equipment actually worn/carried at the snapshot, with its actual damage, armor/weapon/focus/tool statistics, finite ammunition and weight/Load. They are dependent spell props, not copies of the original inventory IDs. No money, treasure value, food/fuel, costly/consumed ingredient, unique/charged magic item, password credential, original owner's title or harvestable material is created. Props count for this body's handling and casting focus where the underlying ordinary focus is permitted. Leaving its custody ordinarily makes that prop vanish; transferring it does not mint equipment or refill its finite ammunition account. NEW native projectile exception: replica ammunition or a replica thrown weapon committed to an actually legal native attack remains functional through that attack’s real flight/collision/resolution, then vanishes at completion or cancellation without recoverable material. Debit the real derivative ammunition/item-use account at commitment. Neither cancellation, missed impact, re-creation nor disappearing ammunition refunds it; no independent transferable projectile or extra attack is created. A replica focus/weapon kept in custody remains usable normally. A genuine magic item is not duplicated: abilities requiring its actual original item remain unavailable until a separately authorized real item is supplied. Real borrowed equipment uses its real owner, attunement, charges and carrying constraints, and drops locally when the duplicate ends/becomes absent. No original body or original gear is consumed, healed, moved or reowned.

## Agency, actions and creator limits
NEW choose controlled-companion agency, not an autonomous second player character. One live Simulacrum application per original creator across both schools; a new successful body replaces the old only after all new admission/placement checks succeed. A counter, successful donor save or failed placement leaves the old nonconcentration body intact. Dead/absent/pending-return bodies still occupy their live application's cap until actually ended. The creation grants no voluntary birth-round action. Its first new regular START/END/cadence/Reaction-refresh opportunities begin with the original owner’s next future regular cycle; an already-underway creation cycle supplies no birth-phase idle-strain vent, recharge or repeated save. Replacing a body does not repeat a durable lineage checkpoint already processed.

Explicitly extend the accepted owner-attached shared companion framework to this body. On the original creator's actual regular turn, one Bonus Action can issue one understood command to this perceived body within60feet and line of effect for its existing attached phase after that regular turn. The execution uses the original creator's shared one-command and, if damaging/control, one-offensive-asset opportunity for that numbered round. Do not create another ledger per duplicate, change controller stats to creator stats, steal a completed/different-body reservation or refund an owner's paid command. It may move up to actual remaining Speed and perform ONE actual native Action or ONE actual native Bonus Action behavior specified by that command, paying its own real resource/component/strain costs. An Attack Action can contain the donor's actual native attacks; no bonus attacks are invented. It receives no second free Bonus Action or independent full turn. Uncommanded behavior is defensive reposition/Dodge only; no off-screen attack, condition, healing, resource generation or professional work loop is implied. Noncombat work/rest needs a real prospective task order, actual uninterrupted time and real inputs; it uses no accelerated combat catch-up.

A native Reaction requires its real source trigger, its own available Reaction and resource credentials. Its budget refreshes once at the original owner's actual regular START; extra turns do not refresh or create an attached phase. An offensive/control Reaction also requires the owner's still-free shared offensive allowance; it cannot double that allowance or debit the creator's separate personal Reaction. Its attached phase supplies source-specific regular START/END/save/recharge/cadence checkpoints for this body only, including the existing one-point idle Dissonance decay only on a genuine regular phase with no spell or magical class ability; it is not an extra owner turn. No owner phase after actual owner death/absence means no commanded execution or refreshed Reaction. Continue only preexisting absolute/registered save/deadline obligations, without inventing actions, recovery or indefinitely frozen hostile effects; where a specific foreign condition lacks a legal phase-to-virtual adapter its complete source integration is a declared prerequisite, not an extra action permission. This proposal supplies the duplicate's own base six-second save-only virtual continuation for its already-existing END-save effects when no owner sequence exists, anchored at last resolved END/application, deduplicated on return to a real phase, with original deadlines unchanged. This is NEW SI-only timing, not a general companion revision. Actual authority transfer requires its own complete accepted source; the creator tag/stat provenance/account do not change. Creator death does not by itself erase the body or grant another controller free ownership.

## Lifetime, healing and endings
NEW instantaneous creation establishes a persistent nonconcentration magical creature/application until actual ending, with no arbitrary finite duration. The same current body can receive actual eligible healing, stabilization/repair and HP prohibitions using its copied active type and real source predicates; no free universal construct repair, resurrection or lost-limb cure is supplied. NEW zero-HP template boundary: an actually dead donor is not an existing creature. A living zero-HP donor is not mislabelled dead, but its snapshotted zero-HP duplicate immediately ends at the creation boundary under this spell’s finite-body lifecycle; it provides no live replacement of an existing Simulacrum, no corpse fuel, healing or inherited Null exception. The paid attempt is not refunded, and the original donor’s Dying/Stable/counters remain unchanged. This local creation-lifecycle choice is not a universal ban on targeting zero-HP creatures. At zero normal HP from subsequent ordinary damage it ends as this finite created body, with no loot/corpse fuel; it is not the donor's death. Explicitly extend the source-qualified finite-body Null rule only here: a genuinely Null-owned zeroing damage root causes NullDisabled instead of this damage-ending event, keeps the same body/account/cap, and permits only independently legal restoration. Independent expiry of a copied-form deadline, dismissal, replacement or actual dispel can still end a NullDisabled duplicate.

Full creating-application suppression saves the SAME body pose/HP/resources/history and makes it absent, with real gear deposited locally; it does not refill HP or end-and-resummon. All world/source deadlines keep advancing. On suppression ending return only at that actual saved pose when the complete body can fit with lawful support; otherwise stay pending until a real local fit or another actual ending. No push, remote relocation, fresh body, auto gear pickup or replayed missed orders. Narrow suppression affects only its actual component/provider, not an automatic full disappearance. A live rank7 application can be ended by an actual qualifying dispel; original donor, real world possessions and prior intrinsic spell consequences are unaffected except where their own source dependencies require cleanup. Original creator may dismiss with an actual Action while perceiving the body/application within120feet; otherwise use actual removal, not an unprinted free global command. At ending dependent props vanish and real items remain locally; preserve the spent derivative account for recast. No afterlife, soul transfer, actual-original resurrection or replacement of the donor's identity is asserted.

Fate Echo remains limited by its independently accepted nondamaging complete-mode gate; this damaging-capable derivative does not acquire Fate eligibility through this paragraph. Cast Echo may create it only through the new paid child route and this spell’s actual full lineage/body/resource rules. An original real Wizard’s settled Soulburn/Grand Reservoir combination is unchanged; a derivative does not evade the explicitly excluded copying/casting-access functions by calling Grand Reservoir an intrinsic recovery grant.

## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

## Ready

Spend an Action to declare a perceivable trigger and one legal Action-time action or movement. It expires next regular own-turn start. **NEW:** only one pending Ready per creature; replacing it loses the prior setup and any paid held-spell costs. No Bonus Action/Reaction ability, long ritual or multi-minute activity can be prepared by generic Ready.

The trigger happens first, then the readied response immediately follows before later events, unless a specific effect explicitly interrupts. On release spend the normal Reaction and recheck target, range, sight/perception, line of effect, ammunition and other prerequisites. An invalid or declined occurrence spends no release resource; the Ready can wait for another valid occurrence before expiry. This does not undo setup costs. Once released, it is consumed.

For ordinary nonspell actions, feature/ammunition costs are paid on release unless text charges setup. A readied **Attack Action** gets its legally available ordinary attack count; a feature limited to your own turn does not thereby work off-turn. Core Overwatch is explicitly one ranged attack, not that full Attack Action and not Soldier's distinct engine.

A readied spell is actually **cast at preparation**: choose spell/mode, verify legality, pay RP/material/other costs, provide components, resolve Dissonance/Refrain and cast-trigger effects once. Counterspell/cast-interruption opportunity occurs then, not again at release. Every held spell requires concentration, even ordinarily non-concentration spells; incompatible prior concentration ends. Lost concentration loses the held spell and costs. NEW: select the legal target/area point at release and recheck legality without repaying. At release the hold continues as ordinary spell concentration if required, otherwise ends after resolution. Expired/replaced/countered held spells do not refund paid costs.

Ready movement grants a separate current-Speed budget on release, pays terrain costs and can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. It grants no extra Action, Bonus Action or interaction.

Focused stance's Reaction restriction also blocks an ordinary Ready release; Ready does not create a Counterspell exception. Holding a spell does not waive any current Reaction prohibition.

**Spell-effect duration begins at release.** Its normal duration is anchored when the effect manifests, while Ready expiry and held concentration already run from preparation. A source explicitly tying a particular consequence to casting/preparation retains that consequence's stated clock. No casting cost, Refrain, Dissonance or cast trigger occurs a second time merely from release.

## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.

## Time and event ordering — NEW

For a duration created in initiative, record the relevant original regular start/end marker. Existing effects keep that **virtual marker**, repeating every six seconds if the creature leaves or changes initiative. Reordering, rerolling, extra turns, death/removal or leaving/reentering initiative never restart an existing duration. New effects use the current schedule. Source death still ends concentration, a source-dependent aura/tether or an effect explicitly ending on death.

- A bare hostile target-bound **N rounds** ends at the Nth future regular target-end marker. An in-progress target turn's current end does not count.
- A bare self/source buff, ally-targeted buff or source-controlled aura **N rounds** ends at the Nth future source-start marker. Explicit target-turn, pulse or absolute timing overrides this default. Activation during source turn 1 for three rounds ends at source turn 4's start.
- **Next turn** means the next future regular turn of the named creature, not the current turn's still-upcoming end. An unqualified next turn refers to source/user under the existing shared rule. Explicit “this turn” can include the current turn.
- An outside-initiative bare N-round effect instead gets an absolute application-time + N×6 seconds deadline. Entering initiative preserves that deadline.
- Explicit periodic profiles retain their registered clocks and tick counts. Never create a second timer merely because a generic duration rule also exists.

The [exact GPT review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_COMBAT_EXACT_FINDINGS.md) confirms ally-buff source clocks and excluding the current turn for explicit next-turn endpoints. The helper excludes a specific current-end marker only if that marker would otherwise be selected: application during a turn at time1 with end3 excludes3 and selects9; application at/after3 also selects9, without erroneously skipping again to15.

At a regular turn's **start**, resolve in this order:

1. Expire start-ending effects and apply immediate state changes from those expirations.
2. Refresh Reaction; tick regular-start recharge/non-action clocks.
3. Resolve already-due absolute state recovery if now legal, including a previously blocked Stable recovery deadline.
4. If still alive, dying and at 0 HP with death saves, make that turn's death save.
5. Resolve other start effects and periodic events in application order.
6. Begin voluntary turn decisions.

At **end**, resolve triggered effects, due damage, saves and maintenance before end-ending effects expire; then the slot finishes. No extra turn creates another regular marker. The caller must not reuse a resolved marker.

For simultaneous effects, earlier application timestamp precedes later. For simultaneous components of one source, its printed internal order controls; otherwise use stable application sequence, with source/mechanical ID as a final tie-break. Record that sequence when creating the effects. Beneficial/harmful labels do not change priority. Periodic family arbitration happens once per family/marker before its damage, retaining the family registry's consumed loser ticks.

Examples: dying at 0 rolls its death save before ordinary start-turn healing; a fatal death save is not undone by ordinary healing. Stable at 0 skips the save, then start-turn damage can break Stable. A natural 20 can restore 1 HP before a due Bleed drops it to 0 as a new drop event. If Decay expires while a Stable recovery deadline is already due, the old deadline resolves once without rerolling recovery time.

## Movement and geometry

Track **spent movement cost**, not distance, for ordinary turn movement. Mode cap = `(1 + number of legal Dash actions this turn) × current Speed for that mode`; remaining = max(0, cap − spent cost). Switching modes never refunds cost. Recalculate cap on Speed changes, preserving spent cost. Stand from Prone costs floor(half current Speed) and requires nonzero Speed and enough budget. Dropping Prone costs no movement.

For each foot traveled, normal/difficult/severe terrain costs 1/2/3; use strongest terrain only. Add +1 for crawling and +1 for squeezing. Crawl in difficult =3:1; crawl+squeeze in difficult =4:1. A nonhostile occupied space counts as difficult terrain. Enter a hostile creature's space only with ≥two-size difference or an express feature; never willingly end in an occupied space. Squeeze through a space one size smaller, with own attack/DEX-save disadvantage and attacks-against advantage.

Walk10 through difficult spends20; switch to Fly30 leaves10. Stand with Speed30 spends15; switching to Fly30 leaves15. Two legal Dashes at Speed30 give cap90; prior expenditure still counts. Interpose/Press grant5 budget: they cannot enter a difficult 5-ft tile costing10. Their separate budgets never refill ordinary movement. Ready movement uses Speed at release; Withdraw uses half current Speed. All voluntary movement requires nonzero relevant Speed.

Forced movement does not use these ledgers or provoke ordinary opportunity attacks, cannot place creatures in solid matter, and stops at obstacles. Teleport does not traverse intervening terrain or spend Speed unless printed; it requires a legal destination. Speed0 alone does not block forced movement or teleport. Flight with Prone/Speed0/lost support causes Falling unless Hover or an explicit magical support exception applies; use the existing fixed Fall Marker procedure. Reaching support ends Falling.

NEW grid metric: each orthogonal or diagonal neighboring tile is 5 ft; use the same metric for ordinary ranges/areas. No diagonal cut through a corner when both adjacent orthogonal sides are completely blocked. Exact templates, 3D geometry, mounts, chases, jumping, climbing/swimming procedures and currents need further source review.

## Resolve a damage event

Resolve each genuinely separate hit or damage event once. Do not split one packet to multiply Wound saves or combine separate hits merely to cross a threshold. Feature-specific prevention that acts before damage or before reaching zero resolves at its printed timing first.

1. Resolve attack/save, damage and applicable defenses. The remaining nonnegative amount is **resolved damage**.
2. Record HP, Wounds and zero-HP state before the event. Remove temporary HP first. **Post-temp damage = resolved damage minus temporary HP absorbed.** Keep this amount even when it exceeds current HP; floor the resulting current HP at zero.
3. Check V6 Instant Death. If post-temp damage minus HP before the hit is at least maximum HP, the creature dies. For a creature already at zero, this is post-temp damage at least maximum HP. Stop: there is no Wound save, death-save failure or successful knockout from that event.
4. Otherwise, a living creature makes one Wound save if it dropped from positive HP to zero, if **2 × post-temp damage is at least maximum HP**, or if the effect actually inflicts Maiming. Overlapping triggers still cause only one save. The post-temp threshold and one-save rule are new provisional interpretations. Maiming is an independent trigger even when temporary HP absorbs all ordinary damage; immunity to Maiming itself still applies.
5. Make a Constitution save against **max(10, floor(post-temp damage / 2))**. Use pre-event Wounds for the -1-per-Wound penalty. Maiming with zero post-temp damage uses DC 10. A Wound gained now cannot penalize the roll that created it.
6. A success adds no Wound. A failure that began with zero, one or two Wounds adds exactly one; failure by 5 or more also gives that Wound one Injury. A failure that began with three Wounds kills the creature instead: no fourth Wound and no Injury roll. Stop processing later living-target consequences if dead.
7. If the creature was already at zero before this event and post-temp damage is positive, end Stable. A creature using death saves adds one failure, or two for a critical hit; three failures kill it. An ordinary creature that does not use death saves dies instead, without starting death counters. A hit from positive HP to zero does not also cause a same-packet death failure.
8. If this event newly reduces positive HP to zero, a valid melee knockout makes the surviving creature Stable. Otherwise a character/significant NPC using death saves begins dying; an ordinary monster dies. A previously Stable creature whose temporary HP absorbed all damage remains Stable unless an independent Maiming result killed it. The Director identifies significant NPCs consistently. Knockout cannot override Instant Death or a fatal Wound save.

Core's Maiming and Wound trigger rules remain subject to an actual feature's eligibility. The reference helper receives already legal events; it does not grant every attack Maiming or a damage-prevention exception.

## Zero HP and recovery

A living character at zero HP is Unconscious. Core's condition already includes Incapacitated, unawareness, dropping held items and falling Prone; an adjacent hit is critical as specified there. Healing does not silently remove other independent causes of Unconscious or Prone.

While dying, make one death save at the **start of each regular initiative turn**. Roll d20 without modifiers unless a feature specifically modifies death saves. Natural 20 restores 1 HP; natural 1 adds two failures. Other results of 10 or more add one success; 9 or less add one failure. Three successes make the creature Stable; three failures make it Dead. Extra turns and Actions add no extra death saves. Stable or Dead creatures do not roll them.

Regaining positive HP or becoming Stable resets both counters. Temporary HP does not raise normal HP, end Unconscious or reset counters. Fully absorbed damage does not end Stable or add a death failure in this provisional interpretation. Independent Maiming can still cause its Wound save.

**Stabilize:** an Action and DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or an Action using one healer's-kit use automatically, stabilizes a living dying creature at zero. It remains Unconscious and makes no death saves. Roll 1d4 once when it becomes Stable and record its absolute recovery time that many hours later. If still Stable then, it regains 1 HP. Damage reaching normal HP cancels that deadline and resumes dying with the appropriate failures. Rest and Stable recovery use the same elapsed clock, so four hours of recovery inside an eight-hour Watch do not cost twelve hours. A later rest does not separately replay the Stable healing event.

**Dead:** ordinary healing and stabilization do not restore life. Resurrection must satisfy its own willing-soul, body, time, cost and target rules. It does not automatically remove Wounds, Corruption, debts, legal death or claims upon the body. Corpses cannot supply repeated resource triggers.

## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.

## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid 3-pulse effect, start is pulse 1; pay maintenance on each of the next 2 regular turns by turn end for pulses 2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn 4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.

Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless explicitly stated, cannot place a creature inside solid matter, and stops at an obstacle. Grapples use the card's save/DC, can be escaped with an Action and STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against that DC, and end beyond reach. A root sets Speed 0 but does not remove Actions. Slows reduce Speed to minimum 0. Silence blocks verbal spells/audible abilities, not all thought or all class features. Charmed effects never determine a player's beliefs; use only the printed action restrictions.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.

### Null Veil

**Duration.** Persists until one listed purge succeeds. Exiting field alone does not end it.

**Passive Insight.** While Veil is active and not suppressed, final passive Insight is 5. This is a setting of that passive score, not omniscience or motive detection. Suppression restores normal calculation for its duration.

**Creation-time nonlethal damage flag.** At creation of each damage root, record root dealer. If that dealer is a character currently under unsuppressed Null Veil, mark the entire root `nullNonlethal=true`. Descendant delayed/ongoing packets inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A distinct later activation/attack creates a new root and re-evaluates. A companion/minion has its own dealer identity. Controller Veil does not convert companion damage unless an exact ability says the controller is the damage dealer. Pure transfer/redirection keeps the original root's nullNonlethal flag. It does not create a second root or extra prevention/resource triggers. An effect that explicitly creates new reflected/retaliatory damage uses the reflector as dealer and evaluates that new root at creation. A mere transfer is not reflection.

When a root is qualifying Null-nonlethal, use this order:

1. Snapshot recipient identity/lifecycle, pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds/death state and the root nullNonlethal flag. Resolve ordinary defenses, resistance and temp-HP absorption and calculate the ordinary post-temp damage/HP loss values; attached non-damage riders remain pending under their own triggers.
2. If nullNonlethal is false, use the ordinary CORE/HEALING_DEATH/lifecycle procedure unchanged. If true, continue below. Objects/noncreature structures still take ordinary object damage and can be destroyed; the word nonlethal does not make objects indestructible.
3. For any living-recipient qualifying damage packet, suppress damage-caused Instant Death and suppress the packet’s Core Wound/Maiming save entirely, including half-maximum and positive-HP Wound triggers. Therefore the packet cannot create a fatal fourth-Wound result while the recipient remains above 0 or reaches 0. Existing Wounds remain recorded.
4. Apply normal HP loss down to minimum 0. Positive→positive: stop the Null zero-state branch; recipient keeps resulting positive HP, existing Wounds/conditions and independent riders. Positive→0 ordinary living: skip damage-caused death/death-save failures and establish Stable0 with counters reset and exactly one ordinary Stable recovery deadline, unless a source-specific zero-HP permission such as actual Undying Spellform applies as stated below.
5. Already Dying0: qualifying damage causes no new damage failure/death and does not stabilize, clear counters or move the existing death-save schedule. Already Stable0: causes no failure/death and keeps the existing recovery deadline exactly; never reroll/extend it. If temp HP absorbs the entire normal-HP loss so HP never reaches0, no zero-state transition occurs.
6. For nonliving/companion/projection recipients, use exactly one explicit recipientLifecycle branch below; do not infer anatomy from a name. The Null override replaces only the damage-caused lethal/destruction endpoint named by that branch. Independent duration, dismissal, concentration/source end, sacrifice/cost, Hunt finality or other non-damage expiry remains real.
7. Would-die/death-trigger protections do not trigger or spend if their prerequisite death/fatal branch was skipped by Null. A source-specific trigger keyed only to damage reducing HP to0 without killing, such as actual Undying Spellform, still triggers. Independent non-damage riders resolve if their own trigger remains true and they do not require a Wound/death result.
8. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are never converted. New reflected/retaliatory damage that is a new root re-evaluates its own dealer; pure transfer/redirection preserves the original root flag and does not duplicate root triggers.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
### Recipient lifecycles for qualifying Null damage

**Ordinary living recipient.** Use orderedAlgorithm steps 3–5. Positive→positive: no packet-created Wound/Instant Death. New positive→0: Stable0 unless an exact source-specific zero permission overrides. Already Dying0: same counters/markers. Already Stable0: same recovery deadline.

**Ranger Beast.** Source normally dies immediately at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces that damage-caused immediate-death transition with Null Disabled at0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no commands/actions; same animal/bond remains. Ordinary legal companion healing above0 ends Disabled. A later independent non-damage death/removal rule still works.

**Finite summon, Familiar or Mirror Beast.** Source normally disappears/ends at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces only that damage-caused zero disappearance with Null Disabled at0 while its original duration/source still exists. Independent duration expiry, dismissal, concentration/source end or replacement still ends it. Legal companion healing above0 restores function; no generic repair/resummon is granted.

**Mage Lich elite.** Source normally becomes destroyed bound asset at0. Qualifying Null damage leaves same elite Null Disabled at0, not destroyed; therefore Soulbound is not legal solely from this zero. Legal companion healing above0 restores it. An independent actual destruction/expiry can later create its normal destroyed state.

**Wizard standard undead.** Qualifying Null damage leaves same minion Null Disabled at0 instead of damage-caused destruction. Dismissal or owner completed-LR expiry still ends it. Legal healing above0 if a real source applies may restore it.

**Authored local projection.** A scene projection whose authored 0-HP rule says disperse/end uses that administrative projection endpoint even under Null; it is not a living death/Wound branch. ACT-FEAST-STEWARD instead uses its explicit Collapsed Projection rule. This classification must be printed in the actor profile, not inferred from a name.

**Undying Spellform.** If qualifying damage newly reduces a Mage with actual Undying Spellform to0 without killing outright, its printed trigger occurs and its 1/LR use is spent. It overrides zero-HP Unconscious/Incapacitated permissions as reviewed: conscious, half-Speed voluntary movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting/concentration, no independent BA/Reaction. Triggering damage still causes its concentration save. If still0 at feature expiry, the reviewed expiry destabilizes/cancels Stable recovery and adds one failed death save; that later feature-expiry event is not the original Null damage packet.

**Would-die protections.** A protection whose trigger requires actual death/would-die/fatal result does not trigger and spends no use when Null skips that damage-caused death branch. Do not replay it later. Separate minimum-HP prevention that resolves earlier follows its own source if actually triggered.

**Actual nonliving Construct.** For an actual nonliving Construct creature with an authored HP/destruction endpoint, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces only damage-caused destruction with Null Disabled0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands. Same construct identity remains; no corpse/parts/loot are generated by the zero. Only an actual repair/heal rule that expressly applies to that construct can raise it above0 and end Disabled; no generic repair is granted.

**Silence Wraith only.** For ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH specifically, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces its damage-caused dispersal with Null Disabled0 (Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions). It has no corpse/soul/loot. The chamber’s independent correct-plate terminal may still pacify/disperse that same identity; no generic healing/repair is invented.

**Local actor bindings.** ACT-TOY-SENTINEL: ordinaryNonlivingConstruct; ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH: localSpirit; ACT-ACCORD-DEVIL: localProjection; ACT-ACCORD-DEMON: localProjection; ACT-ECHO-DOPPELGANGER: localProjection; ACT-FEAST-STEWARD: explicit Collapsed Projection actor rule; ACT-NULL-WITNESS: ordinaryLiving; ACT-GLASS-MENDER-SENTINEL: localProjection.

**What Null Veil does not erase.** Does not remove old Wounds/Injuries, revive Dead creatures, clear existing dying counters, rewrite death history, cure conditions, or prevent non-damage lethal costs/tracks. Newly-zero stabilization resets only its current death-save counters because becoming Stable requires that under Core. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are not converted. This nonlethal override does not alter Hunt finality or Hunted Death rules for actual later deaths from other causes.
